[size=5][b]简介（Introduction）
[/b][/size]
[size=3]原模组链接（Original Mod URL）：
[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9291]Automated Mining Drills

[/url]﻿参考过的汉化模组链接（Referenced Chinese Mod URL）：
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25121]Automated Mining Drills-Chinese translation for 2.0.0[/url]

这是一个以本地化（i18n）为主的模组，仅仅做了有关本地化的格式工作。
This is a localization (i18n)-focused mod, focusing solely on formatting.

主要作用是，将content.json中的展示文本进行提取，并且进行本地规范化。
It primarily extracts the display text from content.json and normalizes it for localization.

更方便其他母语的玩家，针对某种语言进行本地化。[/size]
This makes it easier for players of other native languages ​​to localize the game for a specific language.

[size=3]本模组囊括的文本，仅包含Default（英文）和中文。
This mod only includes the default (English) and Chinese text.

有需要的本地化作者可以参照本地化格式，自行在i18n目录下创建对应语种的json文件，然后仿照Default文件进行文本翻译。
Localization authors can refer to the localization format and create their own json files for the corresponding language in the i18n directory, then translate the text using the default file.[/size]

[size=5][b]如何使用（How To Use）[/b][/size]
[size=3]1、下载原模组
Download Original Mod.

2、解压原模组，放到你的星露谷的Mods目录下
Unzip the original mod and place it in your Stardew Valley Mods directory.

3、下载该模组，解压，[color=#ff0000][b]针对同名文件目录，执行覆盖操作[/b][/color]即可
[/size][size=3]Download the mod, unzip it, and [/size][b][color=#ff0000][size=3]overwrite the files in the directory with the same name.[/size]

[/color][/b][size=5][b]额外的解释（Additional Explanation）[/b][/size]
[size=3]我并没有提前征求原作者的汉化授权（懒）。
I didn't ask the original author for permission to translate the mod into Chinese beforehand (I'm too lazy).

所以，如果原作者你认为我的这个模组侵犯了你的权益，还请告诉我，我将及时删除这个模组。
So, if you, the original author, believe that my mod infringes your rights, please let me know and I will promptly remove it.

当然，在不侵害原作者本人的权利的前提下，包含原作者在内的所有的玩家都可以随意的使用、修改我的这个模组。
Of course, as long as it doesn't infringe on the original author's rights, all players, including the original author, are free to use and modify my mod.

不需要征得我的授权，我也没做什么特别棒的工作，就是做了一个文本的规范化而已。
No need to ask for my permission, and I haven't done anything particularly impressive; I simply standardized the text.

一切解释权归原模组作者所有。
All interpretation rights belong to the original mod author.
